description: Terrain was significantly softer and more waterlogged in early July 2024 than in late July 2023. Deep footprints in the silty terrain can persist for centuries, requiring a complete revision of EVA walking technique mid-expedition.
response: CSO Nicholson introduced real-time terrain navigation protocols: rock-hopping, following stony seams, avoiding smooth surfaces ('oatmeal not porridge' as a field mnemonic).
lesson: Brief all EVA participants on terrain fragility protocols before the first EVA. Earlier in July = wetter = more fragile. This is not a preference — leaving tracks in undisturbed Arctic terrain is a scientific harm.
